SUN_S1E03_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P01.text: I'm sorry, ma'am. That's not me.

SUN_S1E03_P01.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P01.text: Stand there and make me explain my own eyes.

SUN_S1E03_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P01.text: That's a very selective version of events.

SUN_S1E03_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P01.text: Ma'am, I don't know what he hated. I was hoping to get something to eat.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: You left us with the doors chained.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: You always sounded calm when you were lying.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: I don't know what he sounded like.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: They came down hard. Merrit said he'd keep the back way open. Then he disappeared.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: And you think I owe you his answer.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: I can't. But I can sit here while you tell me what happened, if that's any use to you.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: You don't get to be kind and make this easier.

SUN_S1E03_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P02.text: I'm not trying to make it easy.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Who told you he was coming?

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: A preacher. Dust in every seam of his coat and very clean manners.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Name?

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Samuel. Maybe Samuel Hayes. I wasn't taking attendance.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: What did he want?

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: At first? Nothing. That's why I kept listening.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Nobody walks that far for nothing.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: He asked about Merrit. Then he told me a man might come through before the next flare.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: And he described Kael.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Close enough that I stayed angry all week.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Did you tell Samuel what Merrit looked like first?

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: No.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: So somebody is putting Kael in front of people.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Maybe.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: You have a very annoying relationship with that word.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: I like it better than being wrong loudly.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: Are you scared?

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: A little.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: You don't look scared.

SUN_S1E03_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P03.text: I don't see how that would help.

SUN_S1E03_P04.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P04.text: He said he'd come back for all of this.

SUN_S1E03_P04.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P04.text: You always this careful with people you don't know?

SUN_S1E03_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P04.text: When they're holding letters that aren't mine, yes.

SUN_S1E03_P04.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P04.text: You don't want to read it?

SUN_S1E03_P04.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P04.text: You've spent three days trying to turn this into an answer. You should see what the answer would belong to.

SUN_S1E03_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P05.text: We give them a different name. Something ridiculous. If it comes back later, we know somebody carried it.

SUN_S1E03_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P05.text: Because Isabelle is already hurting over one man who isn't here. I'm not adding another one just to see what she does.

SUN_S1E03_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P05.text: I'm not trying to hurt her.

SUN_S1E03_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P05.text: I know. You are still asking to use her.

SUN_S1E03_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P05.text: I'm trying to find the person using us.

SUN_S1E03_P05.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P05.text: The preacher already had your idea.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Isabelle
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: If you find Samuel, tell him I don't like being prepared.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: If he comes back, tell him yourself.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: A first name, a possible last name, and several thousand miles of desert. Excellent.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: It's more than we had yesterday.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: You say that like you enjoyed it.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: Do you really think he doesn't care?

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: He acts like explanations aren't automatically more important than people.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: For him too. He just doesn't know it yet.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: You really need him to be a mystery.

SUN_S1E03_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E03_P06.text: You really need him not to be one.
